result.topic_en: Draft passage in which Riemann restates his dissertation's definition of a function of a complex variable (dw/dz independent of dz) and contrasts it with opposing views: one that derives this property by proof rather than taking it as the definition, and Cauchy's view (stated in connection with a report on Puiseux's work) that any quantity varying with x+yi in an arbitrary way is a function; it ends with a heavily corrected Latin sentence on determining a function's values from its values on a small region.

methods.what: Definition of a complex function: w is a function of z if the difference quotient dw/dz is independent of the differential dz (complex differentiability)
methods.quote:
Eine complexe Größe $w$ heißt eine Function einer andern complexen
Größe $z$, wenn sie mit ihr sich so ändert, daß {+der Werth des Differentialquotienten+} $\frac{dw}{dz}$ von $dz$ un-
abhängig ist.

methods.what: Proof device used in the opposing view: for a function of a+b, the derivative with respect to a equals the derivative with respect to b
methods.quote:
Satz, daß der Differential einer Function von $a+b$ [-...-] nach $a$
genommen gleich ist dem Differential nach $b$.

methods.what: Determination (identity principle): the function's values on a very small region of the argument determine its values for all other arguments
methods.quote:
si [-pro-] {+aliquot+} [?] valoribus [-arg-]
[-mente-] in {+[?]+} [-...-] admodum exigua [-valor-] {+pro+} valoribus
argumenti valor est datus functionis, ex his valores
functionis pro reliquis valoribus argumenti jam sequi.

items.english: it seems permissible to single out some points (where an opposing view is held).

items.quote:
Man betrachtet [-...-] eine complexe Größe {+$w$+} die sich mit einer
andern complexen Größe $z$ {+$=x+yi$+} (allgemein zu reden auf bestimmte Art) oder auf
ganz beliebige Art ändert, als Function [-von-] $x+yi$.
items.english: One regards a complex quantity w which varies with another complex quantity z = x+yi (generally speaking in a definite way) or in an entirely arbitrary way as a function of x+yi.

items.quote:
si [-pro-] {+aliquot+} [?] valoribus [-arg-]
[-mente-] in {+[?]+} [-...-] admodum exigua [-valor-] {+pro+} valoribus

functionis pro reliquis valoribus argumenti jam sequi.
items.english: if for some values of the argument within a very small region the value of the function is given, then from these the values of the function for the remaining values of the argument already follow.
